note: P4257 (Pro 25:3) — as heavens for height and earth for depth, so the heart of kings is unsearchable.

dims.v: inscrutability — the unsearchable depth of a king's heart
the heart of kings, unsearchable as the height of heaven and depth of earth — the inscrutable inner counsel of a ruler, beyond an ordinary man's fathoming
(the heavens and earth it is likened to)
the royal mind whose depths no subject can plumb

leb (heart) — 'so the HEART of kings is unsearchable'; a king's inner thought is as unfathomable as sky and earth. The counsels of power run deeper than a subject can see — a caution to those who would read or manipulate a ruler.
